title: Arch of Trajan at Dura-Europos
description: The Arch of Trajan at Dura-Europos is a triple bay arch located outside walls of Dura-Europos ca. 1.7 km NW of the Palmyrene Gate. An inscription records the dedication to Trajan by the Legio III Cyrenaica and was duplicated on each side of the arch.

properties.description: Honorific arch coordinates mapped by the International [Digital] Dura-Europos Archive (IDEA) and contributed to Wikidata. Based upon a georectified map from figure 23.3 in James, Simon. 2015. “Of Colossal Camps and a New Roman Battlefield: Remote Sensing, Archival Archaeology and the ‘Conflict Landscape’ of Dura-Europos, Syria.” In Understanding Roman Frontiers: A Celebration for Professor Bill Hanson, edited by David J. Breeze. John Donald. https://hdl.handle.net/2381/35974.
